opportunities.title: Autumn 2026 Funding Round

amount.raw: Up to £40,000 for organizations, up to £6,000 for individuals, up to £6,000 for publications, up to £5,000 for digitization, up to £3,000 for events, and up to £25,000 for conservation.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organizations conducting research in British art, visual culture, and architectural history.
opportunities.summary: Grant applications for the Autumn 2026 round of funding are open and will close on Monday 14 September at 11:59pm BST. This round includes grants for individuals and organizations, supporting research projects, publications, exhibitions, events, and conservation.

opportunities.title: ERBA Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to ERBA Members conducting research in British art.
opportunities.summary: ERBA Members can apply for Research Travel Bursaries to support trips for research purposes. The bursary provides up to £250 and can be used for travel, accommodation, and reasonable expenses. Applications close on Monday 14 September, midday BST.
